name: The Association's training construct
brief_source: ASSETS_ARC3_BRIEF.md entry M5; MODEL_SHEETS_BRIEF.md sections 1-3; README_START_HERE.md changes on 27 October
appearance: A heavy stone figure of grey granite blocks bound with brass bands, a blank rounded head, pillar arms, and a small amber test core behind a brass chest grille. It moves on rails of light in the floor.

palette.note: The written design specifies grey granite, brass and amber without hex codes; these are the rendering choices recorded by this set.

locks: 4 m tall; Jaeha reaches its hip. The scale relationship is recorded here; no scale silhouette appears in the art.
Blank rounded granite head with no face, eyes, mouth, horns or helmet.
Broad block chest, pillar-like arms, heavy stone legs with an open walk-through gap, broad stone feet.
Brass retaining bands wrap and bind the blocks; thigh/knee bands and short connecting braces provide climbing footholds.
One small amber test core recessed behind a simple cross-shaped brass grille in a square riveted frame at mid chest.
No second chest core on the back.
Light rails run under the feet; details.png documents the track light.
Matte hand-inked granite, clean cool cel shadows, restrained brass highlights.
No text, labels, logos, scale figures or scene elements on sheets.

files.front.png: Single full-height front design reference, accepted local QA on attempt 2.
files.turnaround.png: Front, front three-quarter, left-facing profile, back; common scale and baseline.
files.details.png: Knee/thigh brass bands, amber test core behind its brass grille, and lower shins/feet on rails of light.
files.prompts.json: Exact built-in tool prompts, reference images, sources, results, disk checks and reject reason.
